reviews.comment:
Hermoso lugar, aprovechamos el descanso y nos tomamos un tiempo, para conocer más adentro ,🤩 el área de arboledas cuidadas, las calles bien señaladas, los lugares de comidas brindan un excelente servicio y la coordialidad que todos esperamos. Aprovechen no solo el parador, les recomiendo conocer Dolores 😍😍 los lugares históricos y la disponibilidad de las personas, me hacen RECOMENDARLO!!!

(Translated by Google)
Beautiful place! We took advantage of the break and spent some time exploring. 🤩 The well-maintained wooded area, the clearly marked streets, the excellent service at the restaurants, and the friendly atmosphere we all expect are all wonderful. Don't just visit the rest stop; I highly recommend exploring Dolores! 😍😍 The historical sites and the friendliness of the people make me want to recommend it so much!
